The definitions and interpretation provisions in the Terms of Use apply to this Payment Policy as if set out in full in this Payment Policy.

If there is any inconsistency between this Payment Policy and the Terms of Use, the Terms of Use prevail to the extent of the inconsistency.

General

  1. 1. This Payment Policy explains how payments are made and processed when Customers purchase products or services through the WeMall platform (WeMall).

  2. 2. WeMall operates as an online marketplace connecting Customers with independent third-party vendors. Payments for products purchased through the Platform are processed using the methods displayed at checkout.

Accepted Payment Methods

  1. 3. Vendors must accept payments through the payment methods made available to Customers, including credit cards, debit cards and other supported electronic payment methods.

Pricing and Payments

  1. 4. All prices displayed on the Platform are in Australian dollars (AUD) and include GST where applicable, in accordance with applicable law.

  2. 5. Any applicable delivery fees, service charges or additional costs will be disclosed before Customers complete their purchases.

  3. 6. Customers must use the payment methods displayed at checkout.

Payment Processing

  1. 7. Payments are processed through a third-party payment service provider.

  2. 8. The payment recipient and merchant of record must be identified at checkout.

  3. 9. Vendors are responsible for managing and processing payments, including addressing payment errors, failed transactions and other payment-related issues.

Failed or Unauthorised Payments

  1. 10. If a Customer’s payment is declined or unsuccessful, the Customer’s order may not be confirmed until payment has been successfully completed.

  2. 11. If a Customer believes that a payment has been made without the Customer’s authorisation, the Customer should immediately contact their bank or payment provider and notify both WeMall and the relevant Vendor.

Refunds

  1. 12. Refunds and cancellations are subject to WeMall's Returns and Refunds Policy, individual listing, the Customer’s contract with the Vendor and Customers’ rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

  2. 13. Vendors are responsible for assessing and processing applicable refunds for products or services purchased from them through the Platform.

  3. 14. Customers should contact the relevant Vendor directly regarding refund requests and payment reversals.

  4. 15. Where a refund is approved or required by law, the relevant Vendor is responsible for arranging the refund in accordance with applicable law.

  5. 16. The time taken for refunded funds to appear in a Customer’s account may vary depending on the Customer’s bank or payment provider.

Payment Enquiries

  1. 17. Customers should contact the relevant Vendor about product charges or refunds and WeMall about the operation of the Platform checkout.

  2. 18. They may contact WeMall at [Insert Contact Email] for further assistance.

Changes to this Policy

  1. 19. WeMall may update this Payment Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on the Platform and will apply prospectively, subject to applicable law.

  2. 20. Nothing in this Payment Policy excludes, restricts or modifies any rights Customers may have under the Australian Consumer Law.
